What an AI may do on its own, and what it never does: write these down first
n: Lines are the short list of what your AI may do on its own and what it never does without you: send, pay, post, delete. Write them down before the work starts, and put them where the AI reads them every time. Clear lines make it easier to say yes to everything else.
